On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure provided by COREMERCH offers a robust alternative. How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal often exclude countries based on various risk assessments and compliance issues, effectively locking out creators in places with challenging financial landscapes. This exclusion can force creators to rely on less secure and more complicated payment methods. In contrast, COREMERCH’s infrastructure is built to support creators in these very regions, offering a seamless setup for accepting cryptocurrency payments. Unlike Stripe or PayPal, which may suspend accounts and hold funds for lengthy periods, COREMERCH provides immediate access to funds, ensuring that the creator maintains full control over their revenue and operations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal are known for their delayed payment processing times, which can lead to cash flow issues for creators. PayPal, for instance, can suspend accounts and withhold funds for up to 180 days without appeal. In stark contrast, COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments, which processes payments in real time with a minimal fee of 0.5%. This means creators can receive payments almost instantly without worrying about lengthy holds or account freezes, significantly improving their financial stability and operational efficiency.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates reliance on restricted platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the critical aspects of sovereignty in commerce is ownership. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal control the user experience and financial flow, meaning creators are at their mercy. COREMERCH, however, empowers creators by giving them full ownership of their commerce stacks. This includes automated payment processing and instant digital product delivery without dependence on external platforms. When a payment is made, the product is automatically delivered to the customer without any manual intervention, ensuring a smooth experience for both creators and their clients.
